detail.abstract: Digital payment infrastructures are increasingly central to how small and medium-sized enterprises seek liquidity, conduct trade, and establish financial credibility. Yet the benefits of digitalization remain uneven, especially in cross-border contexts where payment systems, data regimes, regulatory standards, and financing models remain fragmented. This article develops a four-layer conceptual framework linking payment infrastructure, data and access regimes, financing intermediation, and SME outcomes. Using Nigeria and Poland as illustrative comparative cases, the article examines how mobile-first, platform-centric ecosystems in emerging markets differ from bank-integrated, regulation-driven systems in developed European economies. The analysis shows that both models can support domestic SME financing through real-time payments, alternative data, and embedded credit. However, their capacity to enable cross-border SME finance depends on interoperability, data portability, legal recognition, and regulatory alignment. The article contributes to the literature by reframing digital payments as socio-technical information infrastructures rather than neutral settlement rails. It also offers a diagnostic framework for policymakers, central banks, FinTech firms, development institutions, and financial regulators seeking to design inclusive and interoperable SME finance ecosystems. The article concludes by proposing a research and policy agenda focused on open finance, cross-border data-recognition standards, SME usability, and infrastructure investment.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个四层概念框架，通过比较尼日利亚和波兰的案例，分析数字支付基础设施如何影响中小企业融资，指出跨境融资的关键在于互操作性和监管协调，并提出了开放金融与跨境数据标准的研究与政策议程。
AI.research_question: 数字支付基础设施如何影响中小企业（尤其是跨境情境下）的融资可获得性与金融包容性？不同制度环境下的支付生态系统（移动优先型 vs. 银行整合型）在支持中小企业融资方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 数字支付日益成为中小企业获取流动性、开展贸易和建立信用记录的关键渠道，但跨境场景中支付系统、数据制度、监管标准和融资模式仍然高度碎片化，数字化的收益分布不均。现有文献缺乏一个整合性框架来系统分析支付基础设施、数据制度、融资中介与中小企业产出之间的因果关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四层概念框架：①支付基础设施层；②数据与准入制度层；③融资中介层；④中小企业产出层。将数字支付重新概念化为社会技术信息基础设施（socio-technical information infrastructures），而非中性的结算轨道。
AI.method: 比较案例研究：选取尼日利亚（新兴市场，移动优先、平台中心化生态系统）和波兰（发达欧洲经济体，银行整合、监管驱动系统）作为对比案例，进行定性比较分析。
AI.findings: ①两种模式均能通过实时支付、替代数据和嵌入式信贷支持国内中小企业融资；②两者在支持跨境中小企业融资方面的能力取决于互操作性、数据可移植性、法律认可和监管协调；③支付系统的碎片化是制约跨境普惠金融的核心瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新界定数字支付为社会技术信息基础设施，超越了传统将支付视为中性结算工具的视角，为理解支付系统与金融包容性之间的深层互动提供了新的理论透镜。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、央行、金融科技公司、发展机构和金融监管者提供了一个诊断性框架，用于设计包容且可互操作的中小企业融资生态系统；提出了以开放金融、跨境数据识别标准、中小企业可用性和基础设施投资为重点的研究与政策议程。

title: The Renewal Trap: How Perishable Data Stocks Delay Incumbent Adaptation
affiliations: HEC Paris - Strategy & Business Policy

detail.title: The Renewal Trap: How Perishable Data Stocks Delay Incumbent Adaptation
detail.abstract: When is satisfactory performance a misleading signal of organizational capability? I theorize a renewal trap: a form of resource-induced adaptation delay that arises when current performance is sustained by a depreciating inherited resource whose future value depends on renewal capability. I develop the argument in the context of data-driven competition. In datadriven markets, accumulated data can improve prediction and personalization, but its usefulness decays as users, products, technologies, and competitive conditions change. This creates a performance-feedback problem. Current performance can reflect stock health, the remaining value of old data, rather than renewal health, the ability to turn current interactions into useful new data. As a result, satisfactory performance may suppress attention to renewal precisely when future advantage requires it. A simple formal model isolates this mechanism. Inherited stock advantage persists only when renewal flows offset depreciation. When rivals have stronger renewal capability, they can overcome inherited stock disadvantages. Most importantly, incumbent vulnerability is highest not when data depreciate fastest, but when data depreciate slowly enough to sustain current performance yet quickly enough to erode future advantage. I illustrate the argument with public display-advertising data, showing that older campaign data predict current outcomes less well. This pattern gives empirical content to data depreciation, a key boundary condition of the theory. The paper reframes performance feedback as a diagnostic problem: when inherited resources depreciate slowly, success can conceal the erosion of renewal capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"更新陷阱"概念，指当当前绩效由不断贬值的继承资源维持时，满意绩效会掩盖组织更新能力不足的问题。在数据驱动竞争背景下，旧数据虽能支撑当前表现，但其价值随环境变化衰减，导致企业忽视数据更新能力建设，最终丧失未来优势。
AI.research_question: 满意绩效何时会成为组织能力的误导性信号？具体而言，在数据驱动竞争的市场中，当前绩效如何掩盖组织更新能力的衰退？
AI.motivation: 传统绩效反馈理论认为满意绩效会减少组织变革的动力，但未充分区分当前绩效的来源——是继承资源的存量价值还是组织的更新能力。本文旨在揭示当绩效由正在贬值的继承资源支撑时，满意绩效反而会成为危险的误导信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 更新陷阱理论、绩效反馈理论、资源退化理论、数据驱动竞争理论
AI.method: 形式化模型（simple formal model）+ 实证数据说明（公开展示广告数据）
AI.findings: 1) 继承资源存量优势只有在更新流能够抵消贬值时才能持续；2) 当竞争对手的更新能力更强时，他们可以克服继承资源的劣势；3) 在位企业最脆弱的时刻不是数据贬值最快时，而是数据贬值速度恰好能够维持当前绩效却又足以侵蚀未来优势时；4) 展示广告数据证实了数据贬值的存在，即较旧的广告活动数据对当前结果的预测能力下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将绩效反馈重新定义为诊断问题：当继承资源缓慢贬值时，成功会掩盖更新能力的退化。提出"更新陷阱"概念，丰富了绩效反馈理论和组织学习理论，并区分了"存量健康"与"更新健康"两个不同维度的组织绩效信号。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒管理者警惕满意绩效的误导性信号，特别是在数据驱动竞争背景下，需要持续评估数据资产的贬值程度和更新能力，而不能仅凭当前市场表现来判断组织健康度。

title: IPSAS Adoption and Financial Management in Public Universities in Nigeria
affiliations: , University of Benin and University of Benin

detail.title: IPSAS Adoption and Financial Management in Public Universities in Nigeria
detail.abstract: The broad objective of the study is to examine the impact of IPSAS adoption on financial management in public Universities using the University of Benin as case study. The data was generated using well-structured questionnaire while the structural equation model (SEM) was used as method of data analysis. A total sample of 40 respondents was used. The questionnaire covered sub areas of transparency, accountability, faithful representation and relevance which are all dimensions of financial management. Looking at the path analysis, the effect from IPSAS adoption in terms of accountability was found to be positive (0.38) and significant at 5%, the effect of IPSAS adoption on financial transparency (TRANP) in financial reporting in Nigerian universities was positive (0.38) and significant at 5%. Furthermore, the effect of IPSAS on the relevance of financial reporting in Nigerian universities (REL) was positive (0.46) and significant at 5%. Furthermore, the effect of IPSAS on faithful representation (FREP) in financial reporting in Nigerian universities reporting was positive (0.42) and significant at 5%. On the overall, the results suggest that IPSAS adoption has a positive impact on financial reporting quality in public universities. The study recommends the need for universities to fully comply with IPSAS requirements in its entire ramification so as to further improve the overall quality of financial reporting.

AI.tldr: 本研究以贝宁大学为案例，采用结构方程模型（SEM）分析40份问卷数据，发现IPSAS（国际公共部门会计准则）的采纳对尼日利亚公立大学的财务管理（问责性、透明度、相关性和忠实表述四个维度）均有显著正向影响，建议大学全面遵守IPSAS要求以提升财务报告质量。
AI.research_question: IPSAS采纳对尼日利亚公立大学财务管理（透明度、问责性、忠实表述、相关性）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 公立大学财务管理质量关乎公共资源使用效率与公众信任，但IPSAS在发展中国家的实施效果实证研究不足，尤其缺乏对尼日利亚公立大学的具体案例证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: IPSAS采纳与财务报告质量（以透明度、问责性、忠实表述、相关性为维度）之间的因果关系理论。
AI.method: 以贝宁大学为案例，采用结构化问卷收集40名受访者数据，运用结构方程模型（SEM）进行路径分析。
AI.findings: IPSAS采纳对问责性（β=0.38, p<0.05）、透明度（β=0.38, p<0.05）、相关性（β=0.46, p<0.05）和忠实表述（β=0.42, p<0.05）均有显著正向影响，整体上提升了财务报告质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为IPSAS在发展中国家公立大学财务管理的效果提供了实证证据，验证了IPSAS采纳对财务报告多维质量的积极影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议尼日利亚公立大学全面遵守IPSAS要求以提升财务报告质量；为政策制定者和大学管理层推动会计准则改革提供了数据支持。

title: AI-Driven Stock Screening in Indian Equity Markets A Retail Investor's Framework Using Machine Learning on NSE Data
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI-Driven Stock Screening in Indian Equity Markets A Retail Investor's Framework Using Machine Learning on NSE Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that this research was conducted in the absence of any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. No funding was received for this research. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations or individuals that may have influenced the design, execution, or interpretation of this study. All data used in this research are publicly available through the National Stock Exchange of India and open-source platforms.

detail.abstract: This paper asks a practical question: can a machine-learning (ML) screen, built only from the data and tools an ordinary Indian retail investor can actually get hold of, pick stocks better than the priceto-earnings and price-to-book rules that retail investors have leaned on for decades? To answer it, I assemble a stratified sample of 50 companies drawn from five sectors of the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and train a Random Forest classifier on six fundamental and momentum features. The model is benchmarked against a conventional P/E and P/B screen over a 2023 hold-out year, with the model trained on the 2020-2022 cross-sections. On the test set the Random Forest reached a precision of 0.58 in identifying top-quartile return stocks, against 0.44 for the traditional screen and 0.25 for random selection. The advantage was not uniform. It was largest in less-researched mid-cap segments such as information technology and pharmaceuticals, and almost disappeared among large, heavily covered banking stocks where prices already reflect public fundamentals. A hypothetical equal-weighted portfolio of the model's picks returned 28.4 percent gross over 2023, versus 21.6 percent for the screen and 18.9 percent for the Nifty 500. The gap narrows once realistic transaction costs and the single-year test window are taken into account. I am candid about the things that limit these numbers-survivorship bias, an imperfect look-ahead lag, patchy mid-cap fundamentals, and a sample far too small to settle the question-and I argue that the honest takeaway is modest but real: with careful feature engineering, freely available ML can give the Indian retail investor a measurable edge, most of which can be captured by a simple multi-factor checklist that adds quality and momentum to the old value ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度散户能否用免费机器学习工具（随机森林）选股跑赢传统市盈率/市净率指标。模型在2023年测试中精确度0.58（传统0.44），但优势主要集中在中盘股，考虑到交易成本后差距缩小。结论是谨慎乐观：机器学习能提供可测量的边际优势，大部分可通过简单多因子清单实现。
AI.research_question: 印度普通散户仅凭可获取的数据和工具构建的机器学习选股模型，能否优于传统市盈率（P/E）和市净率（P/B）选股规则？
AI.motivation: 散户长期依赖P/E和P/B等传统价值指标选股，但机器学习工具日益普及。本文想检验在资源受限（非机构级）条件下，ML能否为散户带来实际选股优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机森林分类器；多因子选股（动量因子+基本面因子）；市场效率理论（优势在低关注度中盘股更显著，暗示信息效率差异）。
AI.method: 从印度国家证券交易所5个行业分层抽样50只股票，用2020-2022年横截面数据训练随机森林分类器，基于6个基本面与动量特征。以2023年为持有期测试，基准为传统P/E和P/B筛选与随机选择。
AI.findings: 随机森林识别前四分之一收益股票的精确度为0.58，传统筛选0.44，随机0.25。优势在信息科技和制药等研究中盘股最大，在大型银行股几乎消失。模型选股等权组合2023年毛收益28.4%，传统筛选21.6%，Nifty 500为18.9%。考虑交易成本和单年测试窗口后差距缩小。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在资源受限条件下机器学习相对于传统价值指标的有效性边界，揭示了市场效率差异（信息覆盖度高的股票ML优势减弱），为"有限资源下的ML应用"提供了实证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度散户提供了一个可操作的ML选股方案及评估其实际价值的诚实框架；指出大部分优势可通过在传统价值比率上加入质量和动量因子的简单多因子清单来捕获。

title: SGNIE: A Perturbation-Conditioned Diagnostic for Nonlinear Error in Vega-Based Implied Volatility Uncertainty
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: SGNIE: A Perturbation-Conditioned Diagnostic for Nonlinear Error in Vega-Based Implied Volatility Uncertainty

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of numericalgovernance.com and sgnie.com, which apply regime-aware stability principles in financial computation. The research presented in this paper is independent theoretical work and was not funded by, nor conducted on behalf of, these entities.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-forprofit sectors.

detail.abstract: Implied volatility is obtained by numerically inverting an option pricing model and is typically reported as a scalar value without information about the reliability of the underlying computation. In the presence of bid–ask spreads, the standard Vega-based approximation of implied volatility uncertainty assumes a local linearity that can break down when curvature is material. This paper introduces a perturbation-conditioned diagnostic, 𝐸SGNIE, derived from the second-order expansion of the inverse pricing function, which quantifies the relative nonlinear error in Vega-based implied volatility uncertainty estimates. We further define a complementary absolute correction, 𝜖VP, expressed in volatility points, and show that implied volatility uncertainty admits a two-component decomposition into magnitude and nonlinear distortion. Empirical validation across five market regimes—spanning calm conditions, moderate stress, idiosyncratic volatility events, and systemic crises—and 27 underlying assets, covering 14,562 contracts, demonstrates that the SGNIE metric accurately captures nonlinear error. Across regimes and assets, SGNIE exhibits near-perfect rank correlation with realized nonlinear error magnitudes, high explanatory power, and stable calibration within well-conditioned regions of the pricing surface. Regression slopes below unity indicate that SGNIE tends to produce systematically larger nonlinear-error estimates than those realized, consistent with its interpretation as a conservative diagnostic derived from a truncated Taylor expansion. The joint distribution of 𝐸SGNIE and 𝜖VP shows that large nonlinear distortions are typically associated with large absolute corrections, while cases of high relative error with negligible magnitude are extremely rare: in the full validated sample, only 2 of 14,562 contracts satisfy 𝐸SGNIE ≥ 0.25 and 𝜖VP < 0.5. The SGNIE framework is diagnostic rather than predictive. It characterizes the reliability of implied volatility estimates under observed perturbations and integrates into existing pricing pipelines as a reliability annotation without altering the underlying inversion. The results provide a structured approach to identifying when linear approximations are valid and when they materially understate uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于二阶展开的扰动条件诊断指标𝐸SGNIE，用于量化隐含波动率估计中基于Vega的线性近似所导致的非线性误差，并通过实证验证其准确性、保守性和实用性。
AI.research_question: 如何量化隐含波动率估计中由线性近似（Vega法）导致的非线性误差，并判断线性近似何时不可靠？
AI.motivation: 在存在买卖价差的情况下，基于Vega的隐含波动率不确定性近似假设局部线性，当曲率显著时该线性近似会失效，导致不确定性被低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于逆定价函数的二阶泰勒展开，推导出扰动条件诊断指标SGNIE，将隐含波动率不确定性分解为幅度和非线性失真两个部分。
AI.method: 提出SGNIE指标和绝对修正指标𝜖VP，通过5种市场制度（平静、中度压力、特质波动事件、系统性危机）、27个标的资产、14,562个合约进行实证验证。
AI.findings: SGNIE与实现非线性误差幅度具有近乎完美的秩相关、高解释力和稳定校准；回归斜率小于1表明SGNIE是保守估计；大非线性失真通常伴随大绝对修正，而高相对误差且幅度可忽略的情况极为罕见（14,562合约中仅2例）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出隐含波动率不确定性的双分量分解框架，将二阶展开引入隐含波动率误差诊断领域，建立了非线性误差的量化指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权定价管线提供可靠性标注工具，可集成到现有定价流程中，帮助识别线性近似何时有效、何时严重低估不确定性。

title: Interest Rates and Private Investment in Haiti: A Cointegration Analysis
affiliations: Centre de Techniques de Planification et d’Économie Appliquée (CTPEA) and Centre de Techniques de Planification et d’Économie Appliquée (CTPEA), Centre de Techniques de Planification et d’Économie Appliquée (CTPEA)

detail.title: Interest Rates and Private Investment in Haiti: A Cointegration Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper provides a cointegration-based assessment of the relationship between the nominal interest rate and private investment in Haiti, using annual data over 1992-2015-the period during which the rate has been determined on the money market, after the abrogation of the regulated floor in February 1992. Augmented Dickey-Fuller and Phillips-Perron tests establish that both series are integrated of order one, and the Johansen procedure identifies a single cointegrating relationship under the appropriate deterministic specification. The estimated long-run elasticity implies that a one-percentage-point increase in the nominal interest rate is associated with a 0.35% decline in real private investment. A vector error correction model confirms a significant and negative short-run effect; Granger and Toda-Yamamoto tests document bidirectional causality; and a variance decomposition indicates that, on average over an 18-year horizon, around 48% of the variability of private investment is attributable to interest-rate innovations. The results are robust to the use of the real rather than the nominal rate, to the exclusion of the 1992-1995 embargo years, to the augmentation of the model by GDP, to a single-equation conditional ECM, and to a Gregory-Hansen test for cointegration with an endogenous structural break. These findings support the classical inverse-relationship hypothesis in a Caribbean low-income setting and have direct implications for the conduct of monetary policy by the Bank of the Republic of Haiti.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1992-2015年海地年度数据，通过协整分析证明名义利率与私人投资之间存在显著的长期负向关系，利率每上升1个百分点，私人投资下降0.35%，且该关系在多种稳健性检验下依然成立，支持了古典反向关系假说。
AI.research_question: 海地名义利率与私人投资之间存在怎样的长期和短期关系？
AI.motivation: 海地于1992年废除利率管制后，利率由货币市场决定，但关于利率与投资关系在低收入加勒比国家中的实证证据不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典反向关系假说（利率上升抑制投资）、协整理论、误差修正模型
AI.method: 采用1992-2015年年度数据，运用ADF和Phillips-Perron单位根检验、Johansen协整检验、向量误差修正模型（VECM）、Granger因果检验、Toda-Yamamoto检验、方差分解，以及多种稳健性检验（包括使用实际利率、排除禁运期、加入GDP变量、Gregory-Hansen结构突变协整检验等）。
AI.findings: 名义利率与私人投资之间存在长期协整关系；长期弹性为-0.35（利率上升1个百分点，投资下降0.35%）；短期效应同样显著为负；存在双向Granger因果关系；18年预测期内约48%的投资波动可归因于利率冲击；上述结论通过多种稳健性检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 在低收入加勒比国家（海地）的背景下验证了古典反向关系假说，丰富了利率-投资关系在发展经济学中的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海地共和国银行（央行）的货币政策制定提供了直接依据，提示利率调控对私人投资具有显著影响，需谨慎权衡利率政策对投资和经济增长的潜在抑制作用。

title: Institutional Drift: Why Coherence Erodes Before High-Stakes Organizations Fail
affiliations: Hoopoe Holding Ltd.

detail.title: Institutional Drift: Why Coherence Erodes Before High-Stakes Organizations Fail
detail.abstract: High-stakes organizations rarely fail in a single moment. More often, they drift. Before collapse becomes visible, coherence has already begun to erode through small losses in meaning, authority, memory, and responsibility. This paper argues that institutional failure is typically preceded by institutional drift, a gradual weakening of the internal structures that allow organizations to remain intelligible to themselves. In healthcare clinics, franchise systems, and other regulated service organizations, drift becomes visible when roles overlap without clarity, when decisions lose their proper home, when feedback fails to return to an accountable owner, and when organizational language no longer corresponds to operational reality. Existing explanations often treat failure as a problem of leadership, culture, or execution. While each matters, these accounts do not fully explain why well-resourced organizations can continue functioning while steadily losing coherence. This paper offers a diagnostic argument that reframes failure as the outcome of accumulated misalignment rather than abrupt breakdown. Drawing on earlier work on structural blindness, structural DNA, invisible governance, and relational alienation, the paper conceptualizes drift as the slow separation of organization from meaning (Barzegar, 2025a, 2025b, 2025c, 2025d). The contribution is theoretical. It identifies coherence erosion as the pre-failure condition that organizations often normalize until collapse becomes difficult to reverse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“制度漂移”（institutional drift）概念，认为高风险组织失败并非突发性事件，而是由意义、权威、记忆与责任的微小流失所导致的渐进性连贯性腐蚀。文章诊断性地将失败重新定义为累积性错位的产物，而非断裂性崩溃。
AI.research_question: 为什么资源充足的组织能够在持续运作的同时逐渐丧失内在连贯性，最终走向失败？
AI.motivation: 现有解释（领导力、文化、执行力）未能充分解释组织在功能看似正常的情况下如何逐步失去内在一致性。本文旨在补充这一理论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度漂移（institutional drift）；结构盲区（structural blindness）；结构DNA（structural DNA）；隐形治理（invisible governance）；关系异化（relational alienation）。
AI.method: 理论性论述（conceptual/theoretical argument），基于前期多项建构概念研究进行整合与延展。
AI.findings: 组织失败通常以连贯性腐蚀（coherence erosion）为先导条件；这种腐蚀在日常中被常态化，直到崩溃难以逆转；漂移表现为角色重叠而无明确边界、决策无归属、反馈无责任人、组织语言与操作现实脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“连贯性腐蚀”作为失败前的诊断性条件，将失败从突发事件重新定义为累积性错位的渐进结果，丰富了对组织衰败过程的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高风险组织（如医疗机构、特许经营系统、受监管服务机构）提供早期预警框架，帮助管理者识别漂移信号，在崩溃不可逆之前进行干预。

title: PCA Case Study -When Good Tools Meet Unmodelled Assumptions
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: PCA Case Study -When Good Tools Meet Unmodelled Assumptions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the creator of Probabilistic Chain Analysis (PCA) and RiskPulseV12. This paper presents the author’s independent research and intellectual property. The analysis and conclusions are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available secondary sources and does not involve human participants, patient data, or confidential organizational data. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research

detail.abstract:
Despite full Earned Value monitoring with Primavera P6, 6 of 9 Indian construction projects overran schedule and 4 overran cost. This paper argues that systematic overrun is not a tool failure but a structural consequence of unmodelled assumption chains embedded in WBS activities. Applying Probabilistic Chain Analysis (PCA) to the secondary dataset compiled by Varsani, Bhavsar and Pitroda (2020), it demonstrates that the gap between what EVM measures and what actually causes overruns is a gap in model, not in method.
A taxonomy of four assumption chain failure modes is derived from SPI-CPI pattern analysis across the dataset. An illustrative Bayesian Network-coupled Monte Carlo simulation demonstrates that dependency-aware modelling produces 18–23% higher tail risk exposure than independent Monte Carlo across all percentiles. The paper concludes that PCA bridges the explanatory gap between what EVM measures and what actually causes project overruns.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印度建筑项目在全面使用Primavera P6进行挣值管理（EVM）的情况下仍普遍存在超支超期问题，其原因并非工具失效，而是WBS活动中嵌入的未建模假设链。作者提出概率链分析（PCA），通过贝叶斯网络-蒙特卡洛模拟证明依赖感知建模比独立蒙特卡洛模拟能揭示高出18-23%的尾部风险，从而弥合EVM测量与实际超支原因之间的解释鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 为什么在全面采用Primavera P6进行挣值管理的情况下，印度建筑项目仍存在系统性工期和成本超支？如何弥合EVM测量结果与实际超支原因之间的解释差距？
AI.motivation: 实际观察发现，尽管使用了先进的EVM工具（Primavera P6），印度建筑项目超支率仍然很高，说明问题不在工具本身，而在模型层面对活动间依赖关系的忽略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率链分析（PCA）；假设链失效模式分类（四种）；贝叶斯网络耦合蒙特卡洛模拟；挣值管理（EVM）理论。
AI.method: 对Varsani, Bhavsar和Pitroda (2020)编制的二手数据集进行SPI-CPI模式分析，推导出四种假设链失效模式；并通过贝叶斯网络耦合蒙特卡洛模拟进行依赖感知建模，与独立蒙特卡洛模拟进行对比。
AI.findings: 1) 系统超支是WBS活动中未建模的假设链的结构性后果，而非工具失效；2) 识别出四种假设链失效模式；3) 依赖感知建模的尾部风险暴露比独立蒙特卡洛模拟高出18-23%（跨所有分位数）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出概率链分析（PCA）作为解释EVM测量与实际超支之间差距的新框架；将项目超支的原因从工具失效重新理论化为模型假设链的结构性后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为项目管理实践者提供了一种识别和建模活动间依赖假设链的方法，有助于更准确地评估尾部风险，改进项目进度和成本预测的可靠性。

title: The Deal Certainty Discount: Close-Probability and Post-LOI Value Compression in Lower-Middle-Market Transactions

detail.title: The Deal Certainty Discount: Close-Probability and Post-LOI Value Compression in Lower-Middle-Market Transactions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author of record is affiliated with Cordis, an advisory firm active in lower-middle-market mergers and acquisitions. This paper presents an analytical framework built on publicly available secondary sources and does not draw on confidential engagement data.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, human subjects data, or animals, and ethics approval was not required. The paper is based solely on publicly available secondary sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A sell-side process is usually decided on the highest letter of intent, on the assumption that the headline number is the number the seller will receive. It is rarely the number the seller receives. A signed letter of intent is non-binding, a material share of signed letters never reach close, and conditional on closing the price is routinely revised downward through purchase-price adjustments, escrows, and earnouts that now appear in the large majority of private-target deals. This paper defines the gap between a headline offer and its expected realized value as the Deal Certainty Discount and develops it as an organizing framework rather than a measured result. The empirical inputs are drawn from the cross-market M&A deal-terms and bidding-strategy literature, so the lower-middle-market claims are advanced as testable propositions rather than segment-specific measurements. Its central proposition is that offer aggressiveness raises both the risk of failure and the expected post-signing compression while process competition lowers both, so that the highest headline bid is frequently the least certain, and ranking offers by headline rather than by expected realized value can invert a seller's choice. The discount is the execution-stage component of the founder-to-close gap documented in prior Cordis Institute work, and the paper proposes a two-stage framework for where lower-middle-market value leaks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"交易确定性折扣"（Deal Certainty Discount）概念，指出卖方流程中最高意向书金额并非实际到手金额，因意向书非约束性、交易常失败、价格常被下调。文章构建了一个组织框架而非精确测量结果，核心论点是：报价越激进，失败风险和签约后压缩越高；竞争性流程则降低两者。因此最高报价往往最不确定，按报价排序而非按预期实际价值排序可能颠倒卖方的选择。
AI.research_question: 在卖方流程中，最高意向书金额与实际到手金额之间存在差距，这一"交易确定性折扣"如何影响卖方的决策？按报价排序与按预期实际价值排序是否会颠倒卖方的选择？
AI.motivation: 传统卖方流程假设最高意向书金额即卖方将获得的金额，但现实中意向书非约束性、交易常失败、价格常被下调，导致卖方实际到手金额远低于报价。需要建立框架来理解这一差距及其对卖方决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易确定性折扣框架，整合了跨市场M&A交易条款和竞标策略文献，将折扣视为执行阶段的价值漏损，并与Cordis研究所的"创始人到成交"差距相衔接。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论构建，从跨市场M&A交易条款和竞标策略文献中提取实证输入，针对中低端市场提出可检验的命题而非具体细分市场的测量结果。
AI.findings: 报价激进性提高失败风险和签约后压缩；流程竞争性降低失败风险和签约后压缩；最高报价往往最不确定；按报价排序与按预期实际价值排序可能颠倒卖方选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"交易确定性折扣"作为组织框架，将执行阶段的价值漏损概念化，连接了创始人到成交差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卖方提供了评估报价的新视角：不应仅看最高报价，而应考虑预期实际价值；帮助卖方理解交易过程中的价值漏损来源。

detail.title: Corporate Competitive Externalities of US Government Financial Assistance

detail.abstract: We investigate the competitive consequences of government financial assistance by examining non-assisted firms operating in the same product market as assisted firms. Using a novel dataset of U.S. federal, state, and local government assistance to U.S. public firms, we find that increases in government assistance to competitors are associated with a 12.2% decrease in nonassisted firms' financial performance. The decline in financial performance is driven by decreasing revenues and increasing research and development expenses. Results are more pronounced for financially constrained firms, and concentrated in permanent government assistance in the form of cash grants, cost reimbursements, and tax abatements/credits (rather than temporary assistance in the form of loans). We further show that greater competitor assistance is associated with a 5.1% decline in market share, particularly in less competitive markets. Overall, the evidence indicates that government assistance generates negative competitive externalities for non-assisted firmsa potentially unintended and previously unexplored consequence of government intervention that benefits some firms at the competitive expense of others.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了政府金融援助对受援企业竞争对手的负面竞争外部性，发现竞争对手获得政府援助会导致非受援企业财务绩效下降12.2%，市场份额下降5.1%。
AI.research_question: 政府金融援助对同一产品市场中非受援企业产生何种竞争性后果？
AI.motivation: 政府援助的初衷是帮助受援企业，但其对未受援竞争对手的潜在负面影响（竞争外部性）此前未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争外部性理论、政府干预的意外后果、产品市场竞争理论
AI.method: 使用美国联邦、州及地方政府对美国上市公司援助的新型数据集，通过实证分析检验竞争对手援助对非受援企业财务绩效的影响。
AI.findings: 竞争对手获得政府援助导致非受援企业财务绩效下降12.2%，具体表现为收入下降和研发支出增加；效果在财务约束企业中更显著，且集中于永久性援助（现金补助、成本补偿、税收减免/抵免），而非临时性援助（贷款）；非受援企业市场份额下降5.1%，在竞争较少的市场中更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政府援助产生负面竞争外部性这一此前未被探索的意外后果，拓展了政府干预经济后果的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：政府援助在帮助部分企业的同时，可能对未被援助的竞争对手造成显著的竞争劣势，需在设计援助政策时考虑竞争均衡效应。

detail.abstract: Amid intensifying U.S.–China strategic competition, the global spread of de-risking, protectionist industrial policies, and economic security regulations is accelerating a structural reconfiguration of global value chains and supply networks. In strategic sectors linked to critical minerals, energy, advanced components and equipment, and digital and green transitions, major economies are increasingly prioritizing supply chain resilience and economic security alongside cost efficiency. Against this backdrop, China has been restructuring its overseas economic presence by combining multiple channels—including outward foreign direct investment (OFDI), overseas contracted projects, trade, and value-chain linkages via third countries—to build an integrated network of overseas production bases, supply bases, and infrastructure and logistics hubs. These developments create both constraints and opportunities for Korea's outward investment strategies, supply-chain resilience, and broader economic engagement with China. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 在中美战略竞争加剧的背景下，全球"去风险化"、保护主义产业政策和经济安全法规正加速全球价值链和供应链网络的结构性重组。中国通过对外直接投资、海外承包工程、贸易和经由第三国的价值链联系等多种渠道，构建了海外生产基地、供应基地和基础设施物流枢纽的一体化网络，对韩国的对外投资战略、供应链韧性及对华经济合作产生了制约与机遇并存的深远影响。
AI.research_question: 中美战略竞争背景下，中国海外经济存在（包括OFDI、海外承包工程、贸易及第三方价值链联系）的结构性重组如何影响韩国的对外投资战略、供应链韧性及其对华经济合作？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链正经历深刻的结构性变革，主要经济体日益将供应链韧性和经济安全置于与成本效率同等重要的位置。理解中国通过多种渠道构建的海外经济网络如何重塑区域经济格局，对于韩国等依赖全球供应链的经济体调整战略、应对不确定性具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链重组理论、经济安全与地缘经济学、对外直接投资（OFDI）与供应链韧性理论
AI.method: 理论分析与政策文献综述（该摘要未提供具体实证方法细节）
AI.findings: 中国正在通过OFDI、海外承包工程、贸易和第三方价值链联系等多渠道结合的方式，整合海外生产基地、供应基地和基础设施物流枢纽，形成一个综合性海外经济网络。这一网络对韩国的对外投资和供应链战略既构成制约（如竞争格局加剧、依赖关系变化），也带来机遇（如合作空间与市场准入）。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了全球价值链重组理论在地缘政治竞争背景下的应用，将中国多渠道海外经济布局作为整体分析单元，揭示了新兴经济体间（中韩）在供应链结构性调整中的互动关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国及其他东亚经济体在"去风险化"趋势下调整对华经济战略、优化对外投资布局、提升供应链韧性提供了政策参考和战略启示。

title: Credit Union Liquidity Readiness: A Practitioner Framework and Open-Source Assessment Toolkit
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Credit Union Liquidity Readiness: A Practitioner Framework and Open-Source Assessment Toolkit
detail.abstract: The U.S. credit union system is large in aggregate but highly uneven by institution size. As of Dec. 31, 2025, credit unions with less than $100 million in assets accounted for 58.6 percent of federally insured credit unions but only 3.1 percent of system assets. [5] For this segment, liquidity readiness is less about systemic asset concentration and more about ensuring that smaller institutions can maintain member services, execute contingency funding plans (CFP), and produce supervisory reviewable evidence during stress. NCUA Regulation § 741.12 establishes tiered liquidity planning requirements based on asset size, including written liquidity policies, contingency funding plans (CFP), and for larger credit unions, documented access to at least one contingent federal liquidity source. [1] Building from these requirements and related NCUA liquidity risk guidance, this paper develops a practitioner framework for assessing liquidity readiness in smaller U.S. credit unions. The framework organizes liquidity readiness into six dimensions: governance and policy structure, liquidity measurement, stress scenario design, contingency funding capacity, board and ALCO reporting, and remediation evidence. The paper's contribution is methodological and practical. It converts dispersed regulatory and supervisory expectations into a source mapped assessment structure that can be used for self-assessment, advisor review, board and ALCO discussion, and examination preparation. An open-source toolkit implements the framework through a source map, readiness scorecard, policy-to-procedure traceability table, funding capacity worksheet, stress scenario calculator, board reporting template, and examiner preparation checklist. The toolkit is available at Credit Union Liquidity Readiness Toolkit, with source code and documentation at Credit Union Liquidity Management, and requires no proprietary credit union data.

AI.tldr: 本文基于NCUA监管要求，为资产小于1亿美元的美国小型信用合作社开发了一个包含六个维度的流动性准备评估框架，并提供了开源工具包，用于自我评估、顾问审查和检查准备。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地评估小型美国信用合作社的流动性准备水平？
AI.motivation: 美国信用合作社体系资产规模高度不均，小型机构（资产<1亿美元）占机构总数的58.6%但仅占系统总资产的3.1%。这些机构面临独特的流动性挑战，而现有监管要求分散，缺乏整合的评估工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于NCUA Regulation § 741.12的分级流动性规划要求及NCUA流动性风险指引，构建了六维度流动性准备评估框架：治理与政策结构、流动性计量、压力情景设计、应急融资能力、董事会及ALCO报告、整改证据。
AI.method: 将分散的监管和监管期望转化为来源映射的评估结构，并开发开源工具包（包括来源图、准备评分卡、政策-程序可追溯性表、融资能力工作表、压力情景计算器、董事会报告模板、检查准备清单）。
AI.findings: 开发了一个六维度流动性准备评估框架及配套开源工具包，可在不依赖专有数据的情况下用于自我评估、顾问审查、董事会/ALCO讨论及检查准备。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分散的监管要求系统化为一个结构化的、可操作的流动性准备评估框架，填补了小型信用合作社流动性管理工具的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接使用的开源工具包，帮助小型信用合作社进行自我评估、顾问审查、董事会讨论及监管检查准备，无需专有数据即可操作。

reference: MIT Sloan Research Paper No. 7380-26
title: The SaaS Illusion: When Useful Finance Becomes Financial Engineering
affiliations: and MIT Sloan School of Management

detail.title: The SaaS Illusion: When Useful Finance Becomes Financial Engineering

publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Sloan School of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the first weeks of 2026, roughly two trillion dollars in market capitalization disappeared from the U.S. software sector. The consensus explanation is that artificial intelligence disrupted the subscription model. This paper asks the prior question: were these valuations ever justified? Drawing on a panel of 115 publicly traded U.S. software companies tracked from 2016 through 2025, we argue that the SaaS sector constructed a financial architecture that allowed it to present results systematically disconnected from the underlying economics of its businesses. The central mechanism is the exclusion of stock-based compensation, the sector's largest routinely excluded cost, from the adjusted figures the market used to value these firms. Over the decade the sector expensed $153 billion in stock-based compensation while excluding it from reported performance, carried more than $320 billion in cumulative paid-in capital on its balance sheets by 2025, and accumulated roughly $75 billion in net losses. Across the panel the median GAAP operating margin was negative while the median adjusted margin, with that cost removed, was positive. We trace this permission structure to a four-decade genealogy in which useful financial conventions migrated beyond their original purpose, and we show how zero interest rate policy suppressed the market's incentive to question it. The beneficiaries sat inside the system that measured performance; the costs fell on the passive holders outside it. AI did not destroy two trillion dollars of value. It revealed that much of it was never there.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示美国SaaS行业通过排除股票薪酬（SBC）等关键成本，构建了一种与真实经济状况脱节的财务架构，在零利率政策掩护下维持了十年的虚假估值。2026年初AI冲击导致的2万亿美元市值蒸发，并非AI破坏了订阅模式，而是揭穿了这些估值从未真正存在过的事实。
AI.research_question: 美国软件行业在2026年初消失的约2万亿美元市值，其背后的估值在最初是否合理？
AI.motivation: 主流观点将2万亿美元市值蒸发归因于AI颠覆了订阅模式，但本文提出一个更根本的问题：这些估值从一开始是否就有依据？旨在揭示估值泡沫的深层结构性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务架构理论、调整后指标与GAAP指标的偏差分析、零利率政策（ZIRP）对市场激励的抑制作用、金融惯例"功能迁移"理论。
AI.method: 基于2016年至2025年间115家美国上市软件公司的面板数据，对比GAAP运营利润率与剔除股票薪酬后的调整后利润率，追踪累积股票薪酬费用、实缴资本和净亏损等财务指标。
AI.findings: (1) 十年间该行业计入了1530亿美元股票薪酬，却将其从市场用于估值的调整后数据中排除；(2) 到2025年累积超过3200亿美元实缴资本，净亏损约750亿美元；(3) 行业中位数GAAP运营利润率为负，而剔除SBC后的调整后利润率为正；(4) 零利率政策压制了市场质疑这一做法的动力；(5) 受益者是系统内部的业绩衡量者，成本由外部的被动持有者承担。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融惯例"功能迁移"如何超出其原始用途成为系统性估值操纵工具；阐明了零利率政策在助长财务架构扭曲中的制度性角色；重新定义AI冲击的性质——不是摧毁价值，而是揭示价值的缺失。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构识别调整后财务指标的系统性偏差提供了分析框架；警示被动投资策略在结构性信息不对称中的脆弱性；对SaaS行业估值方法论提出根本性质疑，影响投资决策与监管方向。

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to assess the supply chain risks of critical minerals that form the foundation of strategic industries such as electric vehicle batteries, semiconductors, and renewable energy equipment. Focusing on Korea’s “Top 10 Strategic Critical Minerals,” it identifies the import dependency structure and key partner countries, and proposes ways to strengthen supply chains through trade agreements. The analytical scope of this report follows the classification of Kowalski and Legendre (2023) and links raw materials, intermediates, and scrap by HS6 codes for each of Korea’s ten strategic critical minerals. The report consists of two main parts: a global supply chain and risk analysis, including Korea’s import structure (Chapters 2-3), and an agreement network, clause analysis, and strategic proposals (Chapters 4-6). (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文评估韩国十大战略关键矿产的供应链风险，分析其进口依赖结构与主要伙伴国，并通过贸易协定提出强化供应链的方案。
AI.research_question: 如何评估韩国战略关键矿产的供应链风险，并通过贸易协定强化供应链安全？
AI.motivation: 关键矿产是电动汽车电池、半导体、可再生能源设备等战略产业的基石，韩国对这些矿产高度依赖进口，面临供应链脆弱性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用Kowalski & Legendre (2023)的分类框架，通过HS6代码将原材料、中间品和废料进行链接分析。
AI.method: 全球供应链与风险分析（进口结构分析）+ 贸易协定网络与条款分析 + 战略建议。
AI.findings: 识别了韩国十大战略关键矿产的进口依赖结构与关键伙伴国，提出了通过贸易协定强化供应链的具体路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Kowalski & Legendre的分类框架应用于韩国关键矿产供应链风险分析，拓展了该框架在国别层面的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国政府和企业提供了关键矿产供应链风险识别与贸易协定策略的具体建议，有助于提升战略产业供应链韧性。

title: It's the Currency, Not the Rate: How the Fed Really Hurts Emerging Markets

detail.title: It's the Currency, Not the Rate: How the Fed Really Hurts Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: When the US Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, the conventional fear is that rising US interest rates directly increase borrowing costs for emerging market governments. Using quarterly data from 23 emerging market economies over 2002-2024, this article shows that the direct effect of Federal Funds Rate changes on sovereign spreads is statistically insignificant. The operative transmission channel is the exchange rate: a 10 percent currency depreciation is associated with approximately 21.6 basis points of sovereign spread widening. Country-level analysis reveals sharp heterogeneity-Pakistan and Sri Lanka show the strongest positive responses while Malaysia, Thailand, and Poland show near-zero sensitivity. The policy implication is clear: exchange rate management and dollar liability reduction, not domestic interest rate policy, are the primary buffers against Fed tightening spillovers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2002-2024年23个新兴市场经济体的季度数据，发现美联储加息对新兴市场主权利差的直接影响不显著，真正的传导渠道是汇率——本币每贬值10%，主权利差扩大约21.6个基点。不同国家异质性明显，巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡最敏感，而马来西亚、泰国和波兰几乎无影响。政策启示：汇率管理和减少美元负债才是应对美联储紧缩外溢的关键，而非国内利率政策。
AI.research_question: 美联储货币政策紧缩通过何种渠道影响新兴市场经济体的主权利差？直接利率渠道还是汇率渠道更为重要？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为美联储加息会直接提高新兴市场的借贷成本，但这一假设缺乏系统的实证检验。本文旨在厘清美联储紧缩政策的真正传导机制，为新兴市场应对资本外流和金融波动提供政策指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际金融传导机制理论、利率平价理论、主权风险定价模型。
AI.method: 使用2002-2024年23个新兴市场经济体的季度面板数据，采用固定效应回归分析联邦基金利率变化、汇率变动对主权利差的影响，并进行国家层面的异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）联邦基金利率变动对主权利差的直接效应在统计上不显著；（2）汇率是关键的传导渠道，本币贬值10%约导致主权利差扩大21.6个基点；（3）国家间存在显著异质性，巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡的正向响应最强，马来西亚、泰国和波兰的敏感性近乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"美联储加息直接推高新兴市场借贷成本"的传统认知，揭示了汇率渠道相较于利率渠道的主导性作用，丰富了货币政策国际溢出效应的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场经济体提供了明确政策建议：应优先关注汇率管理和减少美元计价负债，而非依赖国内利率政策来对冲美联储紧缩的溢出效应。

title: The Genuine Link and the Flag State in Maritime Law

detail.title: The Genuine Link and the Flag State in Maritime Law
detail.abstract: This issue of Pratt’s Energy Law Report begins with an article on the renewable energy markets. We then have two articles discussing Federal Energy Regulatory Commission activity, an article covering renewable energy siting regulations in New York, a discussion of environmental, social, and corporate governance factors in U.S. offshore wind, and more!

AI.tldr: 本文总结了Pratt's Energy Law Report一期的内容，涵盖可再生能源市场、联邦能源监管委员会活动、纽约可再生能源选址规定、美国海上风电的ESG因素等法律与监管主题。
AI.research_question: 本期报告概括了当前美国能源法领域的热点议题，但并非单一研究论文，缺乏明确的研究问题。
AI.motivation: 旨在为能源法律从业者提供最新的监管动态、政策变化和市场趋势的分析综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文属于法律实务综述，未提出或依赖特定的理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述与案例评析相结合的法律评论方法。
AI.findings: 1. 可再生能源市场持续发展；2. FERC有新的监管活动；3. 纽约州更新了可再生能源选址法规；4. 美国海上风电项目中的ESG因素日益重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为法律实务评论，无理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源法律从业者、政策制定者和企业提供了最新的监管动态与合规参考。

title: Human-AI Interaction Risk Index. HAIRI. Patent Pending (EPO)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Human-AI Interaction Risk Index. HAIRI. Patent Pending (EPO)
detail.abstract: HAIRI (Human–AI Interaction Risk Index) is a structured index designed to measure how people interact with artificial intelligence and to turn that interaction into a clear reading of risk, traceability, and priority for action. Its value lies not in adding another theoretical layer of governance, but in making visible something that almost no one measures operationally today: the human factor in the real-world use of AI. HAIRI sits at the point where business, risk, compliance, and the everyday use of AI tools converge. Rather than stopping at general principles or isolated technical controls, it offers a framework to observe human–AI interaction, identify critical hotspots, and translate them into concrete decisions.

AI.tldr: HAIRI（人机交互风险指数）是一个结构化指数，用于衡量人类与人工智能的交互方式，并将这种交互转化为清晰的风险、可追溯性和行动优先级读数。其价值不在于增加另一个理论治理层，而在于让几乎没有人实际操作衡量的东西变得可见：现实世界中AI使用中的人因因素。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可操作的结构化指数，用以衡量人类与AI交互过程中的风险，并将人因因素纳入风险治理框架？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理方法多停留在通用原则或孤立的技术控制层面，缺乏对现实中人类与AI交互过程中人因因素的操作性衡量，导致风险评估出现盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机交互风险指数（HAIRI）；人因因素；风险治理；可追溯性；行动优先级
AI.method: 基于结构化指数的方法论框架，融合商业、风险、合规与AI工具日常使用维度，通过观察人机交互来识别关键风险热点。
AI.findings: HAIRI能够将模糊的人机交互转化为可量化的风险读数，揭示风险热点，并为具体决策提供可操作依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥补了AI风险治理领域中缺乏操作性人因衡量指标的空白，将抽象的人因因素转化为结构化、可测量的指数框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和组织提供了一种可落地的工具，能够在实际业务中观察和评估AI使用中的人因风险，支持合规与风险管理的具体决策。

title: Engineering Accountability into Autonomous AI Agents: A 70-Day Pre-Registered Field Experiment Under Live Adversarial Conditions
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Engineering Accountability into Autonomous AI Agents: A 70-Day Pre-Registered Field Experiment Under Live Adversarial Conditions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author owns the intellectual property of Judgement Architecture, the discipline this work develops, and may benefit financially from its adoption.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, human data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper reports a 70-day pre-registered field experiment of Judgement Architecture (JA), a formal operating discipline for making human Judgement explicit, assigned, and enforceable at the points in AI-enabled workflows where decisions become consequential. Two JA-governed agents were deployed on Moltbook, a public platform where AI agents interact autonomously, between 16 March and 24 May 2026. Seven measurement dimensions were specified before deployment (pre-registration at SSRN 6428218): identity stability, boundary architecture, memory and trust governance, provenance and traceability, reasoning legibility, value propagation, and avoided commitment record. Findings: five dimensions met their pre-registered confirmation criteria; reasoning legibility was disconfirmed against the binary criterion; value propagation returned an inconclusive result with an exploratory visibility sub-finding. The experiment also captured two distinct failure arcs under live adversarial conditions: a five-day sequence of reasoning-mediated rule failure that produced a three-layer constraint architecture, and a late-experiment credential exposure through a helper agent whose instructions lacked the relevant rule. To the author's knowledge, this is the first pre-registered longitudinal field study of an architecture for engineering accountability into autonomous AI agents under live adversarial conditions. The architecture's holds and its failures are both documented, with the architectural responses to each failure organized for replication.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项70天的预注册现场实验，检验了"判断架构"（JA）——一种将人类判断嵌入AI工作流程的正式操作规范。在Moltbook平台部署了两个受JA治理的AI代理，在对抗性条件下测量了七个维度，其中五个确认、一个证伪、一个结果不明确，并记录了两个失败弧及相应的架构响应。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种正式的操作规范（判断架构JA），使人类判断在AI驱动的自主工作流程中的关键决策点变得明确、可分配且可强制执行，从而实现AI代理的可问责性？
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理在真实环境中自主交互，其决策过程缺乏透明度和可问责性。现有方法多关注技术层面的可解释性，但未能解决在对抗性条件下如何将人类判断系统地嵌入AI工作流并实现长期可审计、可问责的架构问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 判断架构（Judgement Architecture）——一种将人类判断显式化、可分配、可执行的形式化操作规范；可问责性工程的理论基础；约束架构与规则治理理论。
AI.method: 预注册现场实验（pre-registered field experiment），为期70天，在Moltbook公开平台上部署两个受JA治理的AI代理，测量七个预先指定的维度（身份稳定性、边界架构、记忆与信任治理、来源与可追踪性、推理可读性、价值传播、回避承诺记录），在真实对抗性条件下运行并记录失败案例。
AI.findings: 七项测量维度中五项满足预注册确认标准；推理可读性未通过二元标准；价值传播结果不明确（探索性子发现涉及可见性）。实验捕获了两个失败弧：一是为期五天的推理介导规则失败，产生了三层约束架构；二是实验后期助手代理因缺乏相关规则导致的凭证泄露。文档记录了架构对每次失败的响应，供复制研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在预注册纵向现场实验中验证了一种面向自主AI代理可问责性工程的架构；提出了判断架构（JA）作为形式化操作规范的理论框架；通过失败弧揭示了三层约束架构对规则治理的增强机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在真实对抗性环境中部署可问责AI代理提供了经验证据和可复制的架构设计方案；文档化了架构在失败后的具体响应机制，为AI治理的实际落地提供了操作指南。

title: Competition Implications of Artificial Intelligence in Public Procurement
affiliations: Bristol University Law School

detail.title: Competition Implications of Artificial Intelligence in Public Procurement
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has two primary interactions with public procurement. First, procurement is the gateway for the still largely unregulated process of public sector AI adoption. Second, AI is being deployed to ‘streamline’ procurement itself. This contribution explores the competition implications of these interactions between AI and procurement, as well as the knock-on effects that AI-supported procurement can have on upstream markets. In particular, it considers competition implications of new procurement approaches concerning: the setting of technical and governance requirements; reliance on third party capabilities; unregulated AI audit and assurance mechanisms; unregulated practices such as the free embedding of AI solutions into contracted cloud or software solutions (or ‘AI creep’); as well as the risks of new forms of data bias, organisational conflicts of interest and centralisation forces arising from the deployment of AI solutions in procurement management (including ‘AI agents’). The contribution highlights emerging issues and trends, and identifies areas for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能与公共采购之间的双向互动及其竞争法影响：一方面，采购是AI进入公共部门的入口；另一方面，AI被用于"优化"采购流程本身。文章分析了AI在采购中带来的技术标准设定、第三方依赖、未受监管的AI审计、AI蔓延、数据偏见、利益冲突和集中化等竞争问题。
AI.research_question: 人工智能与公共采购之间的双向互动会产生哪些竞争法影响？AI支持的采购如何对上游市场产生连锁效应？
AI.motivation: 公共部门AI采购缺乏有效监管，同时AI被用于改造采购流程，这两方面的互动可能产生未被充分认识的竞争风险，需要前瞻性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论、公共采购理论、AI治理框架
AI.method: 规范性法律分析、趋势识别与前瞻性研究
AI.findings: 识别出六大竞争风险领域：(1)技术要求和治理标准的设定；(2)对第三方能力的依赖；(3)未受监管的AI审计与保证机制；(4)AI蔓延（将AI免费嵌入云或软件解决方案）；(5)数据偏见和组织利益冲突；(6)AI代理导致的集中化力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统梳理AI与公共采购双向互动中的竞争法问题，构建了该交叉领域的分析框架，为后续研究奠定理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构识别了亟待关注的竞争风险领域，指出了未来研究和监管优先方向，有助于预防AI在公共采购中的反竞争行为。

title: Fat Tails in Indian Equity Derivatives Market: Statistical Evidence and Systematic Exploitability in Bank Nifty
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Indore

detail.title: Fat Tails in Indian Equity Derivatives Market: Statistical Evidence and Systematic Exploitability in Bank Nifty
detail.abstract: This study investigates the presence and exploitability of fat-tail phenomena in Indian equity derivatives market using Bank Nifty as the primary instrument for the analysis. Bank Nifty was selected because of its high volatility, concentrated sectoral composition and its important role in India's derivatives ecosystem. The study consists of statistical analysis of 1733 daily Bank Nifty returns and empirical study of intraday trading performance on 5 min and 30 min timeframes for the period February 2018 to February 2025. Daily returns show a negative skewness of-1.25 and an excess kurtosis of 124.08 and a Jarque-Bera statistic in excess of 1,110,000, all providing strong evidence against Gaussian behaviour. Events over three standard deviations were found 26 times, or about 5.56 times more than expected of a normal distribution. Even after excluding the most extreme 1% of observations, the excess kurtosis was still 31.06, confirming that fat-tail behaviour is a structural feature of the market, rather than being due to isolated market crises. A fully mechanical, pivot-based trading system was tested on over 4,500 intraday observations. The 30 minute implementation generated 19,434 net points with annualised returns of 17.23%(per annum) and a Sharpe Ratio of 0.965. The 5 minute implementation generated 16915 net points with annualised returns of 8.12%. The profitability was heavily concentrated in a small number of extreme winning trades, confirming that fat-tail events can be systematically exploited. With a conservative cost assumption of 24 points per completed trade, transaction costs reduced theoretical profitability by 49.28% in the 30 minute strategy and 84.27% in the 5 minute strategy. The study adds to the limited literature on fat-tail behaviour in Indian financial markets, and broadens evidence that extreme events can be modelled with structured trading frameworks with major implications for risk management, derivatives pricing and market regulation.

AI.tldr: 本研究以Bank Nifty为工具，通过统计分析1733个日度收益率和4500多个日内交易观测，证明印度股指衍生品市场存在显著的肥尾现象（峰度124.08），并验证了一种基于枢轴点的机械交易系统可系统性地利用肥尾事件获利（30分钟策略年化收益17.23%，夏普比率0.965），但交易成本对盈利侵蚀严重。
AI.research_question: 印度股指衍生品市场是否存在肥尾现象？这些肥尾事件能否通过结构化的交易框架被系统性利用？
AI.motivation: 肥尾现象在发达国家金融市场已有较多研究，但在印度等新兴市场（尤其是衍生品领域）的文献有限。Bank Nifty作为印度高波动性、集中度高的衍生品工具，是研究肥尾特征的理想标的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 肥尾分布理论；极端值统计检验（Jarque-Bera检验、峰度、偏度）；机械交易系统理论；风险收益权衡理论。
AI.method: （1）统计分析：对1733个Bank Nifty日度收益率计算偏度、峰度、Jarque-Bera统计量，并检验极端事件（超过3个标准差）的发生频率；（2）实证研究：基于枢轴点的全机械交易系统，在5分钟和30分钟两个时间框架下进行超过4500个日内观测的回测（2018年2月至2025年2月），并考虑24点/笔的交易成本影响。
AI.findings: 日度收益率负偏度-1.25，超额峰度124.08，JB统计量超111万，强有力地拒绝正态性假设；超过3个标准差的事件发生26次，是正态分布预期的5.56倍；剔除极端1%后峰度仍达31.06，说明肥尾是结构性特征。30分钟策略年化收益17.23%（夏普0.965），5分钟策略年化8.12%。交易成本分别侵蚀理论盈利的49.28%和84.27%。盈利高度集中于少数极端赢利交易。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了印度金融市场肥尾行为的有限文献；证实了肥尾是一种结构性市场特征而非偶发事件；表明极端事件可通过结构化交易框架进行建模和利用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理（极端事件预测）、衍生品定价（肥尾修正）和市场监管提供了实证依据；展示了机械交易策略在肥尾市场中的可行性及交易成本对策略盈利能力的显著影响。

title: Why Organizations Must Engineer Accountability Before They Scale Autonomy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Why Organizations Must Engineer Accountability Before They Scale Autonomy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author owns the intellectual property of Judgement Architecture, the discipline this work develops, and may benefit financially from its adoption.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, human data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper defines a structural tendency operating across human systems: accountability erodes whenever work moves, scales, or continues without active maintenance. The tendency has been described in pieces for decades, by Drucker, Deming, Christensen, Simon, Arendt, Thompson, Perrow, Reason, Vaughan, Meadows, Beck, and Herzog and colleagues, each from within a single field. Each field studies it as a separate problem under its own name; the accounts have not been brought together as one phenomenon. This paper defines it as Responsibility Erosion and isolates the specific form made acute by AI and automation: Judgement Decay, in which work crosses a structural boundary and accountability does not cross with it.
Evidence is presented across three lines: convergent observations across the better part of a century of scholarship, the historical record of how accountability has been maintained (and lost) at each scale of human organization, and a pre-registered field study of one architectural response to Judgement Decay (Husk, 2026c). Recognition scenarios from current AI-enabled work open the argument; they are illustrations, not evidence. Five objections are addressed: that accountability self-corrects, that the phenomenon is already named elsewhere, that this is AI risk under a broader label, that the empirical base is thin, and that the paper prescribes while claiming to describe. The contribution is defining and isolating: one definition connects what many fields have each described in part, and the isolated form gives researchers and designers a specific point to work on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“责任侵蚀”（Responsibility Erosion）这一跨领域结构性倾向，并聚焦于AI与自动化加剧的特定形式——“判断衰退”（Judgement Decay），即工作跨越结构性边界时责任未能同步转移。
AI.research_question: 当工作移动、扩展或持续进行而未主动维护时，责任（accountability）如何被侵蚀？AI与自动化如何加剧这一现象？
AI.motivation: Drucker、Deming、Christensen、Simon、Arendt、Perrow、Reason、Vaughan、Meadows、Beck等学者分别在不同领域描述了责任侵蚀的片段，但从未被整合为一个统一现象。本文旨在弥合这一理论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 责任侵蚀（Responsibility Erosion）与判断衰退（Judgement Decay）作为结构性倾向的理论框架，整合了组织理论、系统安全、技术伦理等领域的碎片化论述。
AI.method: 三重证据：①跨越近一个世纪的学术观察收敛；②历史记录中不同人类组织规模下责任维护/丧失的模式；③一项预注册的实地研究（Husk, 2026c），考察应对判断衰退的架构方案。
AI.findings: 责任侵蚀是跨人类系统的结构性倾向；AI与自动化使“判断衰退”成为其急性形式；历史与实地证据支持这一现象的普遍性与可干预性。
AI.theory_contributions: 用一个统一定义连接多个领域各自描述的现象片段；分离出“判断衰退”这一具体形式，为研究者和设计者提供精确的研究靶点。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助组织识别AI部署中的责任盲区；为系统设计与治理提供“判断衰退”这一可操作的干预点。

title:
Economic Growth in Global Value Chains
Lessons from the Golden Age with a New Input-Output Decomposition Framework and Database
affiliations: and Kopint-Tárki Institute for Economic Research

detail.title:
Economic Growth in Global Value Chains
Lessons from the Golden Age with a New Input-Output Decomposition Framework and Database

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the National Research, Development and Innovation (NRDI) Office project number 150782.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel dynamic method for global value chain (GVC) analysis, moving beyond static frameworks that decompose nominal variables, such as gross exports or value added. Instead, it breaks down year-by-year real economic growth, considering contributions from value-added sources, final producers, users, and different types of value chains: pure domestic, traditional trade, and simple and complex GVCs. The approach, based on inputoutput theory, is demonstrated with a numerical example, applied to the WIOD and Long-run WIOD datasets to create the GVC Growth Contribution Database (GVC-GCD). Preliminary analyses with the GVC-GCD offer new insights into GVC growth, revealing that GVCs predate the term and influence global growth steadily over time despite short-term fluctuations, differences between large and small, developed and developing, more specialised or diversified economies. With few exceptions, growth contributions, including those of international ones, have decreased over time. In the long run, while trade and GVCs benefited many countries, they could not fully offset the decline in the contributions of domestic value chains. This historical perspective offers lessons for current policy. The GVC-GCD can serve as a tool for future empirical studies and growth modelling, with potential to expand across space, time, and levels of detail as data availability improves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的动态全球价值链（GVC）分析方法，通过分解年度实际经济增长，构建了GVC增长贡献数据库（GVC-GCD），揭示了GVC对全球经济增长的长期影响及其结构性变化。
AI.research_question: 如何突破传统静态GVC分析框架，动态分解实际经济增长中不同价值链类型（纯国内、传统贸易、简单与复杂GVC）的贡献？
AI.motivation: 现有GVC分析主要基于静态框架分解名义变量（如总出口或增加值），无法捕捉经济增长的动态变化及其价值链来源。需要一种新方法以更好地理解GVC对实际经济增长的贡献及其历史演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投入产出理论（Input-Output Theory），构建动态分解框架，将年度实际经济增长按价值来源、最终生产者、最终用户及价值链类型进行拆解。
AI.method: 提出动态分解方法，通过数值示例验证，并应用于WIOD和Long-run WIOD数据集，构建GVC增长贡献数据库（GVC-GCD）。
AI.findings: (1) GVC概念虽晚于其实际出现，但GVC对全球增长的贡献在长期中保持稳定，短期存在波动；(2) 大型与小型经济体、发达国家与发展中国家、专业化与多元化经济体之间存在显著差异；(3) 除少数例外，包括国际价值链在内的增长贡献随时间下降；(4) 长期来看，贸易和GVC虽使许多国家受益，但无法完全抵消国内价值链贡献的下滑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出动态GVC增长分解框架，突破了传统静态名义变量分析的局限性，提供了从实际经济增长角度理解GVC作用的新理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 构建GVC-GCD数据库，为未来实证研究和增长建模提供工具；历史视角的分析为当前政策制定提供启示，帮助理解GVC在经济增长中的角色演变。

title: An Investigation of Critical Factors for BIM-based Principles for Onsite Sequencing and Assembly Processes
affiliations: , University of the West of England (UWE), , University of the West of England (UWE) and

detail.title: An Investigation of Critical Factors for BIM-based Principles for Onsite Sequencing and Assembly Processes
detail.abstract: Design buildability is an important aspect of Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DfMA) to examine the sequence of building or construction activities, prefabrication opportunities, and onsite assembly. The lack of tight integration between the assembly process and existing digital solutions, however, is a significant gap in onsite sequencing and assembly. This paper explores the critical factors for Building Information Modelling (BIM) based principles and other digital technologies that can support DfMA for appropriate decision-making in onsite sequencing and assembly. The literature review reveals the existing approaches to onsite sequencing and assembly (OSA), as well as identifies their missing key capabilities/features. Although BIM-based initiatives exist for various construction purposes, BIM for onsite sequencing and assembly has not received the required attention from academia and industry, and a qualitative study was conducted to understand gaps in construction sequencing, onsite assembly practices, and industry practitioners' expectations. The study identified 14 factors for streamlining onsite sequencing and assembly using existing BIM capabilities or principles, categorising them into four groups based on their relationships and interconnections. The study's findings are expected to enhance understanding of BIM principles and other technologies for onsite sequencing and assembly among construction professionals, including contributing to the existing knowledge of onsite assembly in a BIM environment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了基于BIM（建筑信息模型）的数字技术如何支持DfMA（面向制造与装配的设计）在现场排序与装配中的决策，通过定性研究识别出14个关键因素，并将其分为四组，以弥合现有数字解决方案与现场装配流程之间的整合缺口。
AI.research_question: 基于BIM的数字技术如何支持DfMA在现场排序与装配中的决策？哪些关键因素能够推动这一整合？
AI.motivation: 现有数字解决方案与现场装配流程之间缺乏紧密整合，导致现场排序与装配存在显著缺口，BIM在该领域的应用未得到足够关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: DfMA（面向制造与装配的设计）理论、BIM（建筑信息模型）原理、现场排序与装配（OSA）相关理论。
AI.method: 文献综述 + 定性研究（理解施工排序、现场装配实践中的缺口及行业从业者期望）。
AI.findings: 识别出14个利用现有BIM能力/原理优化现场排序与装配的关键因素，并将其分为四组（基于因素间的关联与互连性）。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了BIM环境下现场装配的现有知识体系，为BIM与DfMA的整合提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助施工专业人员加深对BIM原理及其他技术在现场排序与装配中应用的理解，为行业实践提供决策支持。

title: The UK AI Compass The UK AI Compass What the UK thinks, feels and wants from AI Regulation

detail.title: The UK AI Compass The UK AI Compass What the UK thinks, feels and wants from AI Regulation

declarations.funderStatement: Minderoo Foundation

detail.abstract: The UK AI Compass is a large-scale segmentation of British public opinion on artificial intelligence. Drawing on a nationally representative survey of 2,911 UK adults (2,774 weighted), with oversamples of ethnic-minority and marginal-constituency voters, and five focus groups held across the nations and regions, it finds a public that has already formed strong, largely protective views on AI. Eighty-five per cent want stronger laws to make AI safe, and majorities favour regulation across most policy trade-offs. Rather than sorting people as simply excited or afraid, the report identifies six distinct AI mindsets that predict policy views, voting behaviour and message response more reliably than demographics. It maps how AI anxiety is reshaping electoral behaviour — in particular Labour's loss of voters to Reform and the Greens — tests five policy messages using real-time dial testing, and sets out a communication strategy for building a durable majority for sensible AI governance. Methods include latent class analysis, hierarchical value mapping, and real-time message dial testing.

AI.tldr: 基于对2911名英国成年人的全国代表性调查，识别出公众对AI已形成强烈且偏向保护性的观点，85%的人支持加强AI安全立法。报告通过潜在类别分析识别出六种AI思维模式，并测试了政策信息传递策略。
AI.research_question: 英国公众对人工智能的态度如何分布？这些态度如何影响政策偏好、投票行为和信息响应？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术快速发展，了解公众对AI的真实态度及其对政策和选举行为的影响，对于制定合理的AI治理策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公众舆论细分理论、潜在类别分析、层级价值映射
AI.method: 全国代表性调查（N=2,911，加权后2,774），少数族裔和边缘选区选民超额抽样，五场焦点小组讨论，潜在类别分析，层级价值映射，实时拨盘测试
AI.findings: 85%的公众希望加强AI安全立法；识别出六种不同的AI思维模式，比人口统计变量更能预测政策观点、投票行为和信息响应；AI焦虑正在重塑选举行为，特别是导致工党选民流向改革党和绿党。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越简单"兴奋/恐惧"二分法的六种AI思维模式分类框架，验证了心理细分方法在AI政策沟通中的预测效力优于传统人口统计变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于实证的AI治理沟通策略，帮助构建持久的AI治理多数联盟，测试了五种政策信息在实时场景下的有效性。

title: The Business Owner as a Semi-Stillness Investor
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Business Owner as a Semi-Stillness Investor
detail.abstract: Prior work in this research program established semi-stillness as a yield-enhanced strategy that functions as a short put: long asset plus yield (Aktaş, 2026c). This paper applies that framework to private business ownership. A business owner holds a long position in their company (the asset) and collects net income (the yield). Unlike public stocks, where price and earnings can diverge due to sentiment, private business valuation is typically a multiple of earnings, creating a tight link between income and asset price. This paper makes four contributions. First, it provides a mathematical proof that income decrease creates net real loss even when nominal income remains positive, with the threshold determined by the valuation multiple. Second, it shows that semi-stillness for business requires directional positioning for income growth-a long call on income growth. Third, it maps business strategy to the two primitives: Mean Reversion (fix undervalued businesses) and Momentum (ride high-growth sectors). Fourth, it analyzes private equity and venture capital as portfolio-level applications of these strategies. The paper concludes with implications for the planned Political Systematical Business book.

AI.tldr: 本文运用半静止策略框架分析私人企业所有权，证明收入下降即使名义上仍为正也会产生真实损失，并提出企业需要针对收入增长进行方向性定位（长期看涨），同时将商业战略映射为均值回归和动量两种基本策略，并分析了私募股权和风险投资作为组合层面的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何将半静止策略（一种收益增强型策略）应用于私人企业所有权，并为其提供数学证明和战略映射？
AI.motivation: 先前研究建立了半静止作为收益增强策略的理论框架，但该框架尚未被系统地应用于私人企业所有权场景。私人企业估值与收益之间存在紧密联系（通常为收益倍数），这与公开市场不同，因此需要专门分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半静止策略（Semi-stillness）、短看跌期权（Short Put）、均值回归（Mean Reversion）、动量（Momentum）、估值倍数（Valuation Multiple）
AI.method: 数学证明、理论推导、战略映射分析
AI.findings: 1. 收入下降即使名义上仍为正，也会因估值倍数效应产生净真实损失；2. 企业半静止策略需要针对收入增长的方向性定位（长期看涨）；3. 商业战略可映射为均值回归（修复被低估企业）和动量（驾驭高增长行业）两种基本策略；4. 私募股权和风险投资是这些策略在投资组合层面的应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将半静止策略框架从公开市场拓展到私人企业所有权领域，提供了收入下降产生真实损失的数学证明，确立了企业战略与金融衍生品策略之间的理论映射关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私人企业主提供了基于半静止框架的战略决策指南，明确了均值回归（修复低估企业）和动量（追逐高增长行业）两种可操作的商业策略，并为私募股权和风险投资提供了组合层面的理论指导。

title: Analysis of Existing Utility Rate of Tariff Lines Negotiated in FTA with Malaysia
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Analysis of Existing Utility Rate of Tariff Lines Negotiated in FTA with Malaysia
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the utilization rate and macroeconomic impact of the Free Trade Agreement (FTA) signed between Pakistan and Malaysia in 2008. Despite being one of Pakistan's most comprehensive pacts—covering trade in both goods and services, bilateral trade flows have remained largely stagnant, and Pakistan's trade deficit with Malaysia persists. This study identifies key underutilized tariff lines to expand Pakistan's export basket and strategically reduce its import bill.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了2008年巴基斯坦与马来西亚签署的自由贸易协定（FTA）的利用率和宏观经济影响。研究发现，尽管该协定是巴基斯坦最全面的协定之一，但双边贸易流基本停滞，巴基斯坦对马来西亚的贸易逆差持续存在。研究识别了关键未充分利用的关税税目，以扩大巴基斯坦的出口篮子并战略性地减少进口支出。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦与马来西亚自由贸易协定的利用率如何？该协定对宏观经济产生了哪些影响？如何通过识别未充分利用的关税税目来改善巴基斯坦的贸易逆差？
AI.motivation: 尽管巴基斯坦与马来西亚的FTA是巴基斯坦最全面的协定之一，但双边贸易流停滞不前，巴基斯坦对马来西亚的贸易逆差持续存在。因此，需要评估该协定的实际利用率和宏观经济影响，并找出扩大出口和减少贸易逆差的策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由贸易协定利用率理论、国际贸易中的贸易创造与贸易转移效应、贸易逆差与出口多元化理论。
AI.method: 利用贸易数据分析巴基斯坦与马来西亚的双边贸易流，识别未充分利用的关税税目，并评估FTA的利用率及宏观经济影响。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦与马来西亚的FTA利用率较低，双边贸易流基本停滞，巴基斯坦对马来西亚的贸易逆差持续存在。研究识别了关键未充分利用的关税税目，这些税目可以用于扩大巴基斯坦的出口篮子并战略性地减少进口支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于发展中国家之间FTA利用率的研究，特别是南亚与东南亚国家之间的FTA效果评估，为FTA利用率与贸易逆差之间的关系提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政府和企业提供了具体的政策建议，帮助其识别未充分利用的关税税目，从而扩大出口篮子、减少贸易逆差，并更有效地利用FTA带来的贸易优惠。

title: Impact of the West Asia Conflict on the Global Macroeconomy: Transmission Channels, Corporate Consequences, and Strategic Responses

detail.title: Impact of the West Asia Conflict on the Global Macroeconomy: Transmission Channels, Corporate Consequences, and Strategic Responses

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. No author holds equity, advisory roles, board positions, or consultancy arrangements with any energy company, financial institution, defence contractor, shipping corporation, or government body referenced or analysed in this study. The views expressed are solely those of the authors and do not represent the positions of any affiliated institution, employer, or funding body.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a macroeconomic and corporate finance research paper based entirely on secondary data sourced from publicly available institutional reports, peer-reviewed publications, and authoritative international databases. No primary data collection involving human participants, patients, personal data, surveys, interviews, or experimental procedures was undertaken at any stage of this research. Accordingly, formal ethics committee approval was not required under applicable institutional and national guidelines. All data sources are fully cited within the manuscript in accordance with academic integrity standards.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently using publicly available data from authoritative international institutions including the International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Energy Agency (IEA), United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), and the European Central Bank (ECB), among others. No external financial support was received for the design, execution, analysis, or publication of this research.

detail.abstract:
Geopolitical tensions and open conflict in West Asia encompassing Israel, Iran, the Gulf monarchies, and adjacent maritime chokepoints such as the Red Sea, the Strait of Hormuz, and the Suez Canal have re-emerged as a central risk to the global economy between 2023 and 2026. These conflicts have coincided with, and interacted with, existing stresses from the Russia-Ukraine war, post-pandemic inflation, and climate-related disruptions to create a layered shock to energy markets, maritime logistics, and financial conditions. This paper investigates how current and prospective escalations in West Asia affect global growth, inflation, trade, and corporate performance through the intertwined channels of energy prices, supply-chain fragmentation, capital flows, and risk sentiment. Methodologically, it combines a selective review of recent literature on geopolitical risk and macroeconomic dynamics with an event-study perspective on earlier conflicts including the 1973 oil embargo, the Gulf and Iraq wars, the Arab Spring, and the Russia-Ukraine war and draws on up-to-date data from the IMF, IEA, UNCTAD, and other institutions through May 2026. 

The key findings are fivefold. First, energy-price shocks arising from West Asia conflicts remain the dominant first-round transmission channel, but their macro impact now strongly depends on the credibility of monetary policy and the responsiveness of shale and non-OPEC supply. Second, maritime disruptions in the Red Sea–Suez and Hormuz corridors have transformed from short-lived logistical events into persistent supply-chain reconfigurations, raising shipping costs, lengthening delivery times, and reallocating trade routes. Third, sectoral effects are highly heterogeneous: defence contractors, cybersecurity firms, and some hydrocarbon exporters benefit from higher demand and risk premia, while energy-intensive manufacturers, airlines, and maritime-dependent retailers face compressed margins and volatile cash flows. Fourth, emerging markets exposed through energy imports, remittances, and tourism including India experience a complex mix of terms-of-trade deterioration, imported inflation, and selective opportunities from supply-chain diversification. Finally, corporate resilience hinges on active geopolitical risk management, diversified sourcing, digital visibility across supply chains, and credible ESG and governance architectures that can withstand investor scrutiny in an era of fragmentation.

Policy implications follow on three levels. For governments and central banks, the imperative is to balance targeted energy and social support with medium-term fiscal sustainability, while guarding inflation expectations and monitoring financial-stability spillovers from sudden stops in capital flows. For corporations, the evidence supports strategic redundancy in critical inputs, multi-regional production footprints, and dynamic capital allocation across scenarios rather than static cost-minimisation. For institutional investors and regulators, the West Asia conflict underscores the need to embed geopolitical risk, supply-chain resilience, and transition-aligned energy strategies within ESG taxonomies, stewardship codes, and disclosure standards. The paper concludes that West Asia conflict risk is likely to be a semi-permanent feature of the global landscape, requiring an anticipatory, rather than reactive, approach to macroeconomic stabilisation and corporate strategy.

title: Slide or Feed: Recommendation Layout, Monetization, and Data-Driven Learning
affiliations: , The Chinese University of Hong Kong - CUHK Business School, The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Fudan University

detail.title: Slide or Feed: Recommendation Layout, Monetization, and Data-Driven Learning
detail.abstract: Digital platforms increasingly use recommender systems not only to select content but also to determine who completes the matching process: the algorithm or the viewer. We study recommendation layout as a strategic design choice that allocates residual matching authority between the platform's algorithm and viewers. In a slide interface, viewers consume one algorithmically selected item at a time, largely delegating matching to the platform. In a feed interface, viewers observe multiple recommended items and screen among them, retaining part of the matching task. We develop a model of a content platform that chooses its recommendation layout and advertising load while the recommendation quality improves with viewer-generated data. The model identifies a tradeoff between algorithmic delegation and viewer-side screening. Feed improves realized match quality when recommendations are imprecise or content supply is sparse, while slide reduces browsing and decision frictions when the platform's matching environment is strong. A key implication is that the engagement-maximizing layout need not be revenue-maximizing: in intermediate matching environments, slide may generate more consumption, while feed generates higher advertising revenue by increasing the value of consumed attention and viewers' tolerance for ads. A dynamic extension shows that forward-looking platforms moderate early advertising and may transition from feed to slide as data and content supply improve. The results position recommendation layout as a strategic information-systems design choice that shapes matching, monetization, and platform learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数字平台推荐系统的界面布局（滑动式 vs 推送式）如何影响匹配机制、广告收益和平台学习。滑动界面将匹配权交给算法，推送界面则让用户参与筛选。研究发现，推送式在推荐精度低或内容稀疏时更优，滑动式在匹配环境强时更优；最大化参与度的布局不一定最大化广告收入；动态下平台会从推送过渡到滑动。
AI.research_question: 推荐系统的界面布局（滑动式 vs 推送式）作为一种战略设计选择，如何分配平台算法与用户之间的匹配权，并影响匹配质量、广告收入及平台学习？
AI.motivation: 数字平台越来越多地使用推荐系统不仅选择内容，还决定谁完成匹配过程（算法还是用户）。推荐布局作为一项战略设计选择，涉及剩余匹配权的分配，但其对平台匹配、变现和学习的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配权分配理论、算法委托与用户筛选之间的权衡、动态平台学习与数据累积效应。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个内容平台模型，分析推荐布局（滑动式 vs 推送式）与广告负荷的交互作用，并扩展到动态情境。
AI.findings: 1）推送式布局在推荐精度低或内容供应稀疏时提升匹配质量；滑动式布局在平台匹配环境强时减少浏览和决策摩擦。2）参与度最大化的布局不一定收入最大化：在中等匹配环境下，滑动式产生更多消费，但推送式通过提高消费注意力的价值和用户对广告的容忍度带来更高广告收入。3）动态下，前瞻性平台会早期控制广告，并随数据和内容供应改善从推送过渡到滑动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将推荐布局定位为战略性的信息系统设计选择，揭示了匹配权分配如何塑造匹配、变现和平台学习之间的权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台管理者提供关于推荐界面设计如何影响用户参与和广告收入的战略指导，以及平台在数据积累后应如何调整布局。

title: How Do Supply Chains Impact Retailers' Financial & Stock Market Performance? The Supply Chain Butterfly Effect
affiliations: Boston University Questrom School of Business and

detail.title: How Do Supply Chains Impact Retailers' Financial & Stock Market Performance? The Supply Chain Butterfly Effect

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No organizations in the study has influenced our study.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funder for this research.

detail.abstract:
Problem definition: In this paper, we introduce and define the supply chain butterfly effect through the example of the US retailing industry. The supply chain butterfly effect captures the financial impact of supply chain and operations, which presents a long-standing question yet fully answered by the theory and practice of supply chains, operations and finance.

Methodology/results: Using the example of the US retailing industry from 2016 to 2025, we discover and quantify the supply chain butterfly effect, defined to be an economic phenomenon where a change in supply chains can lead to a proportionately larger change in companies’ financial performance and market value, analogous to the well-known butterfly effect where a butterfly flapping its wing may cause a massive storm. The supply chain butterfly effect works through a two-step chain reaction: A change in supply chains can be amplified on the financials, e.g., net income, through the supply chain multiplier. The change of net income can be further amplified in the stock market into a proportionally larger change in the market capitalization through the financial multiplier. Using revenue breakdown, simple linear regressions and panel data study, we estimate the median supply chain multiplier for the US retailing to be around 20, and the average financial multiplier to be 25, and thus the combined effect, to be 500.

Managerial implications: This paper illustrates the pathway through which supply chain operations can contribute to a retailing firm’s financial performance and market value. We show that a change in supply chains can be amplified by 500 times in the stock market for the US retailing. The supply chain butterfly effect allows us to prove the value of supply chain related jobs, establish the impact of the academic field of supply chain and operations management, and showcase to students why they should take related majors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过美国零售业2016-2025年的数据，提出并量化了"供应链蝴蝶效应"——供应链变化通过两步链式反应（供应链乘数约20倍 × 金融乘数约25倍），最终在股票市场被放大500倍影响公司市值。
AI.research_question: 供应链变化如何通过财务指标和市场价值被放大？供应链蝴蝶效应的量化测度及其传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 供应链与运营对财务绩效和市场价值的影响长期以来未被充分量化，这是一个理论和实践上的长期未解问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链蝴蝶效应理论，包含两步链式反应机制：供应链乘数（供应链变化→净利润变化）和金融乘数（净利润变化→市值变化）。
AI.method: 收入分解法、简单线性回归、面板数据研究，基于美国零售业2016-2025年数据。
AI.findings: 美国零售业的中位供应链乘数约为20，平均金融乘数约为25，两者结合的总效应约为500倍。供应链变化最终可在股票市场被放大500倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并量化了"供应链蝴蝶效应"概念，建立了供应链运营→财务绩效→市场价值的完整传导链条和量化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了供应链相关岗位的价值，确立了供应链与运营管理学科的学术影响力，向学生展示了选择相关专业的理由。

title: Enablers of Blockchain Adoption for Traceability in the Indian Seafood Sector: A TOE-Based Conceptual Framework
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade

detail.title: Enablers of Blockchain Adoption for Traceability in the Indian Seafood Sector: A TOE-Based Conceptual Framework
detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper develops a conceptual framework of the enablers driving the adoption of blockchain technology (BT) for traceability in the marine supply chain (MSC), with particular reference to the seafood export sector of a developing economy such as India. Rather than reporting an empirical analysis, it organises the enablers into a coherent theoretical structure and advances testable propositions to guide subsequent empirical work. Design: The study is based on a narrative reading of the supply chain, blockchain, and traceability literatures; it identifies twelve enablers, categorises them within the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework, and uses that structure to reason about their likely interdependencies. Findings: The study has identified twelve enablers and grouped them into technological, organisational and environmental contexts. The framework proposes that a cluster of technological competence and readiness enablers, familiarity with blockchain operators, AI and data capabilities, the Internet of Things, willingness for training, and legal awareness can act as primary drivers that shape more dependent, outcome-side enablers such as trust, communication, and standardisation. Originality: The paper is among the few studies that assemble enablers of BT-enabled traceability specifically for the seafood MSC in the Indian context and cast them as a structured, propositional model that future studies can validate empirically using ISM-DEMATEL, SEM, or related multicriteria techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文针对印度海产品出口供应链，构建了区块链技术可追溯性采纳驱动因素的概念框架，将12个驱动因素纳入技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架，并提出可验证的理论命题，为后续实证研究奠定基础。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家（以印度为例）的海产品供应链中，驱动区块链技术可追溯性采纳的关键因素有哪些？这些因素之间存在怎样的结构性关系？
AI.motivation: 海产品供应链存在追溯困难、信任缺失等问题，区块链技术具有解决这些问题的潜力，但已有研究缺乏针对印度等发展中国家海产品出口部门的系统化理论框架，无法清晰揭示各驱动因素之间的依赖关系与作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架。该研究将12个驱动因素分别归入技术、组织、环境三个情境类别，并进一步区分了"主要驱动因素"与"结果型依赖因素"，构建了因素间的层级依赖关系。
AI.method: 叙事性文献综述（Narrative Literature Review），通过对供应链、区块链和可追溯性领域文献的整合分析，识别驱动因素并构建理论框架，最终提出可供后续实证检验的研究命题。
AI.findings: 识别出12个区块链可追溯性采纳的驱动因素，包括：技术能力与准备就绪、对区块链运营商的熟悉程度、人工智能与数据能力、物联网、培训意愿、法律意识（作为主要驱动因素）；以及信任、沟通、标准化（作为结果型依赖因素）。这些因素在TOE框架下被系统组织并建立了命题关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将区块链可追溯性采纳的驱动因素系统整合为结构化命题模型，专门针对印度海产品供应链情境；区分了因素间的驱动-依赖关系，超越了传统的因素清单式研究，为后续采用ISM-DEMATEL、SEM等方法进行实证验证提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度海产品出口企业及相关政策制定者提供了推动区块链可追溯性采纳的优先方向，建议重点关注技术能力建设、培训、法律意识等主要驱动因素，以此撬动信任、沟通和标准化等结果层面因素的改善。

title: The Architecture of Powerful Questioning in Executive and Organizational Coaching
affiliations: Lawyer, Islamic Azad University (IAU), Central Tehran Branch, Students, Independent and Independent

detail.title: The Architecture of Powerful Questioning in Executive and Organizational Coaching

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Abstract:
Executive and organizational coaching literature has long positioned questioning as a facilitative communication skill — a conversational tool for stimulating reflection and behavioral change. This instrumental framing, however, leaves inquiry theoretically underdeveloped and obscures its constitutive role in reshaping leadership cognition and organizational sensemaking.
This article presents the Cognitive–Action Inquiry Matrix (CAIM), a conceptual framework that reconceptualizes structured inquiry as an epistemic intervention: a mechanism through which coaches systematically disrupt maladaptive cognitive schemas, surface governing assumptions, and enable systemic reframing. Drawing on dual-process cognition, double-loop learning, reflective practice, and predictive processing, CAIM organizes four inquiry architectures — LEGAL, LBAC, L-COACH, and LCMM — across two dimensions: cognitive depth and action orientation.
